LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.0.label: Open the Books
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.0.description: Retains the chosen Wealth awakening. Refinement: silver income. Fractional silver carries over. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.1.label: Trade Dividend
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.1.description: When cumulative net trade income exceeds its previous peak, earn 5% of the increase as silver. Purchases count as expenses; buying back and reselling cannot pay twice. Fractions carry forward. One colony account persists through negotiator and route changes. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.2.label: Procurement Fund
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.2.description: Bank 7.5% of new peak net trade income as procurement credit instead of cash. A later trade with a net silver expense can redeem credit for up to 10% of that expense. Fractions and unused credit persist; leaving this branch pauses redemption. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.3.label: Bulk Dispatch
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.3.description: Each 500 silver of new peak net income earns a freight receipt initially worth 3.4 silver; surplus progress carries forward. A later trade with fresh net income redeems older receipts, while receipts created in that trade wait. Splitting orders creates no extra receipts. Progress and receipts survive route changes, and each receipt keeps its value at creation. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.4.label: Varied Stock
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.4.description: Record actually exported goods in trades with fresh net income. Three distinct products complete a docket worth 5% of new net income earned while collecting, initially capped at 5.1 silver. Redeem it by exporting a different product in a later trade with fresh net income. That trade cannot also start another docket. Split stacks count once; dockets and earned value persist through route changes. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.5.label: Workshop Supplies
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.5.description: Industrial purchases first reserve procurement credit at 5% of each covered unit's actual price, using at most 50% of net silver expense per trade. Completed recipes that really consume that material initially replenish 50% of the covered quantity. Fractions persist. The account matches quantities by material type, not individual physical stacks. Resale cancels funded units first; hauling and splitting add no quantity. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.6.label: Household Reserve
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.6.description: Food and medicine purchases reserve procurement credit at 5% of their actual price, capped at 50% of net silver expense per trade. Actual colonist eating or medicine consumed while tending or operating initially returns 50% of covered units, carrying fractions forward. Quantities are matched by material type; resale cancels registered units first. Hauling, free tending and actions without consumption grant nothing. Surgery must complete its medical-bill processing and consume medicine; its clinical outcome need not be successful, but an exception grants nothing. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.7.label: Rotating Shipments
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.7.description: When redeeming freight, export a product absent from the trade that created the previous batch to earn an extra 25% of the redeemed freight value. Fresh net income is required. Repeated goods still redeem ordinary freight without the rotation supplement. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.8.label: Trade Circuit
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.8.description: Completing a docket opens a 30-day order with that trader, initially worth 50% of the docket. Export goods for fresh net income to another trader, then return and do the same with the original trader. Keep one order at a time. Expired orders pay nothing; a later new docket can open another. Ordinary docket redemption continues. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.9.label: Supply Relay
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.9.description: Consuming funded materials in a completed recipe opens one relay worth 25% of that completion's replenishment entitlement, even below one whole item. A different colonist completing a different recipe with actual funded consumption settles the original materials. Keep one relay and carry fractions forward; settling cannot open another in the same completion. Leaving the branch pauses it. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.10.label: Stock Rotation
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.10.descriptio: Alternate actual funded food and medicine consumption to gain an extra 25% of the later consumption's household replenishment entitlement. The first use starts the sequence; repeated use of the same category grants no rotation reward. Terms freeze at the preceding category switch. Leaving the branch pauses it; fractions persist. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.11.label: Freight in Kind
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.11.descriptio: Convert payable freight and rotation supplements into industrial procurement credit, initially at 750% of their value. Buying materials, components or chemfuel refunds up to 10% of the lesser of eligible goods cost and net silver expense, limited by saved credit. Unused credit persists and pauses outside this branch. Refunds never count as fresh trade income. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.12.label: Cash Settlement
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.12.descriptio: New freight receipts settle immediately with an extra 50% of their value. Rotating Shipments still rewards actual different exports. Old receipts settle once at their original value without retroactive settlement premiums. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.13.label: Joint Orders
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.13.descriptio: After a circuit settles, its two traders each request a different product from the original docket. Within 30 days, export the requested goods to their respective traders for fresh net income. Completing both earns 100% of that circuit reward. Keep one joint order at a time and retain completed deliveries. The creating trade cannot deliver it; deliveries do not also advance another circuit. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.14.label: Goods Exchange
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.14.descriptio: Settling a trade circuit also grants supply exchange credit worth 500% of its payout. Later purchases of stackable supplies grant extra units of the item bought, valued at the transaction price. Their value is capped at 10% of that deal's net silver expense, and the extra quantity cannot exceed the quantity purchased. Only whole items are delivered; unused credit remains. Leaving the branch pauses use of the credit. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.15.label: Raw Material Reserve
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.15.descriptio: Supply relays return an extra 500% of their basic material entitlement, limited to funded materials actually consumed. Components do not qualify. Quantities freeze when the relay opens; fractions carry forward and bonus materials are not automatically funded again. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.16.label: Precision Spares
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.16.descriptio: Supply relays also earn industrial component progress worth 375% of their material entitlement, while retaining ordinary replenishment. Convert using base market values when the relay opens and freeze that quantity. Fractions accumulate across orders until a whole component can be delivered; no funded consumption means no progress. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.17.label: Meal Rotation
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.17.descriptio: When rotation returns to food, retain ordinary supplies and bank 500% of the rotation reward's nutrition as packaged survival meal progress. Use actual nutrition received, capped at the base nutrition of consumed goods. Fractions persist across rotations and saves; bonus goods are not automatically funded. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.18.label: Medical Rotation
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Wealth.nodes.18.descriptio: When rotation returns to medicine, increase its rotation reimbursement by 500%, returning the funded medicine actually consumed. Fractions accumulate until whole units can be delivered. Injuries, scars, free treatment and treatment counts alone grant nothing. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: income ×10.
